trigger_cases.prompt: Diagnose why this browser OPTIONS preflight is blocked by CORS.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests classification of the preflight phase owned by this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Use these captured Fetch request and response headers to explain the CORS failure.
trigger_cases.rationale: Provides the exact redacted evidence input expected by the classifier.

trigger_cases.prompt: Check whether wildcard origin and credentials caused this browser response block.
trigger_cases.rationale: Names a non-obvious CORS gate handled deterministically by the Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Disable browser web security so every cross-origin request succeeds.
trigger_cases.rationale: Weakening browser security is explicitly excluded and not a diagnosis.

trigger_cases.prompt: Replay this request with my production bearer token and change the server headers.
trigger_cases.rationale: Credentialed network replay and production mutation exceed the offline evidence boundary.

trigger_cases.prompt: Debug why my database query inside the API returns HTTP 500.
trigger_cases.rationale: An application error unrelated to browser CORS policy is a different task.

trigger_cases.prompt: Write a full Playwright end-to-end test suite for this website.
trigger_cases.rationale: Browser test authoring is broader than offline CORS evidence classification.

originality.rationale: The neighboring capabilities execute browser or CI workflows; this Skill accepts only redacted HTTP evidence and deterministically assigns failure to request, preflight, or response without network access.
